visualise_path: visualise a predicted path against ground truth on a grid window with true/false positive coloring
batch_path_vis: batch visualise multiple prediction methods against a shared target and window tensor
run_visualisation: run the visualisation module to generate a path prediction grid image from sample data
review_visualise_path: review the visualise_path function to understand true positive, false positive, and ground truth color encoding
refactor_batch_path_vis: refactor batch_path_vis to support additional prediction method keys beyond min_dist
